content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand to GitLab France S.A.S., how does the length of paid parental leave differ for a first child?","answer":"In New Zealand you can receive up to 26 weeks of paid Primary Carer Leave, while in France you get 16 weeks of paid leave for a first child.","evidence_a":"Primary Carer Leave can last up to 26 weeks and must be taken in one continuous period.","evidence_b":"First or second child: 16 weeks (6 weeks before birth, 10 weeks after)"}
